runtime_build_note: Run build-bundle.sh on a Linux build machine to produce the self-contained venv archive. Until a pre-built bundle is published, the Linux Agent must install fuzzysully from the requirements-lock.txt. No runtime pip/git/build tools are needed after the bundle is deployed.
_comment_server_basic_exclusions: hello/secure_channel/session are not handled with Basic256Sha256 per upstream docs
_comment_gds_requires_basic: GDS requires Basic256Sha256; None is not supported
_comment_reverse_none_only: Reverse mode supports None policy only
_comment_targeted_nodes: Nodes from the Fuzzowski request graph that are NEVER the fuzz target in any existing high-level function but CAN be targeted via goto_path(). These are legitimate additional profiles.

targeted_nodes.description: Targets the CreateSession request node directly via Fuzzowski goto_path. Exercises application-layer session establishment message fields, nonce encoding, and application-identity certificate parsing while keeping Hello and OpenSecureChannel as non-fuzzed prerequisites.

Targets the ActivateSession request node directly via Fuzzowski goto_path. Exercises identity token, locale, and extension-object fields in session activation while running the full prerequisite chain as non-fuzzed traffic.
Targets the CloseSession cleanup message directly via Fuzzowski goto_path. Fuzzes session teardown handling including delete-subscriptions flag and session-id encoding.
Targets the CloseSecureChannel cleanup message directly via Fuzzowski goto_path. Fuzzes secure-channel teardown encoding, token-id validation, and sequence-number handling.
Targets the CloseSecureChannel message in Basic256Sha256 Sign mode. Exercises secure-channel teardown with active message signing.
Targets the ReverseHelloError response message sent to a reverse-connecting OPC UA client. Fuzzes error-code encoding and reason-string handling in reverse-connection rejection paths.

function_descriptions.hello: Fuzzes the OPC UA Hello message that initiates the TCP-level connection, exercising transport-layer parsing, buffer sizes, and protocol version negotiation.
function_descriptions.secure_channel: Fuzzes OpenSecureChannel/CloseSecureChannel requests to exercise security token negotiation, lifetime handling, and channel-level protocol state.
function_descriptions.session: Fuzzes CreateSession/ActivateSession/CloseSession to exercise application-level authentication, session nonce handling, and identity token parsing.
function_descriptions.find_server: Fuzzes the FindServers service to test discovery endpoint parsing and response handling.
function_descriptions.find_server_on_network: Fuzzes the FindServersOnNetwork service covering multicast/LAN discovery protocol fields.
function_descriptions.get_endpoints: Fuzzes the GetEndpoints service covering security-mode/policy advertisement and endpoint URL handling.
function_descriptions.register_server2: Fuzzes the RegisterServer2 service to exercise server-registration message parsing and callback handling.
function_descriptions.read: Fuzzes the Read service covering NodeId, attribute id, and index-range parsing across the OPC UA address space.
function_descriptions.browse: Fuzzes the Browse service covering BrowseDirection, ReferenceTypeId, NodeClassMask, and result continuation.
function_descriptions.browse_next: Fuzzes the BrowseNext continuation request covering ContinuationPoint handling and result assembly.
function_descriptions.history_read: Fuzzes the HistoryRead service covering time-range, history-mode, and continuation-point handling.
function_descriptions.translate_browse_path_to_node_ids: Fuzzes the TranslateBrowsePathsToNodeIds service exercising relative path element parsing.
function_descriptions.add_nodes: Fuzzes the AddNodes service testing server-side address-space mutation, type-checking, and reference consistency.
function_descriptions.register_nodes: Fuzzes the RegisterNodes service testing NodeId list handling and performance-registration paths.
function_descriptions.unregister_nodes: Fuzzes the UnregisterNodes service testing deregistration state and reference cleanup.
function_descriptions.create_subscription: Fuzzes the CreateSubscription service testing publishing interval, keepalive, and priority handling.
function_descriptions.publish: Fuzzes the Publish service testing acknowledgement, retransmit-queue, and sequence-number handling.
function_descriptions.create_monitor: Fuzzes the CreateMonitoredItems service testing NodeId, sampling interval, filter, and queue-size handling.
function_descriptions.delete_monitor: Fuzzes the DeleteMonitoredItems service testing monitored-item lifecycle and reference cleanup.
function_descriptions.modify_monitor: Fuzzes the ModifyMonitoredItems service testing in-place parameter update and filter modification.
function_descriptions.start_signing_request: Fuzzes the GDS StartSigningRequest operation testing certificate-request encoding and application-identity fields.
function_descriptions.start_new_key_pair_request: Fuzzes the GDS StartNewKeyPairRequest operation testing key-pair generation request encoding.
function_descriptions.finish_request: Fuzzes the GDS FinishRequest operation testing request-id resolution and certificate delivery.
function_descriptions.finish_request_start_signing_request: Fuzzes a combined FinishRequest-then-StartSigningRequest chained GDS workflow.
function_descriptions.finish_request_start_new_key_pair_reques: Fuzzes a combined FinishRequest-then-StartNewKeyPairRequest chained GDS workflow.
function_descriptions.get_trust_list: Fuzzes the GDS GetTrustList operation testing trust-list encoding, certificate-group-id handling, and FileNodeId references.
function_descriptions.get_certificate_groups: Fuzzes the GDS GetCertificateGroups operation testing group enumeration and node-id list handling.
function_descriptions.get_certificate_status: Fuzzes the GDS GetCertificateStatus operation testing certificate-chain validation and status encoding.
function_descriptions.revoke_certificate: Fuzzes the GDS RevokeCertificate operation testing certificate-identifier parsing and revocation state.
function_descriptions.reverse_hello: Fuzzes the OPC UA ReverseHello message, targeting compatible OPC UA clients that accept reverse connections from a server endpoint.
